title: Cattan, Rodrigues & Congedo 2019 — Passive Head-Mounted Display Music-Listening EEG dataset (PHMD)
description: This dataset comprises electroencephalographic recordings from 12 healthy subjects during music listening with and without a passive head-mounted display (PHMD). The study employed a resting-state paradigm with 16-channel EEG acquisition (512 Hz sampling rate) across 10 blocks per subject, alternating between smartphone switched-off and switched-on conditions. The dataset provides raw, unfiltered EEG data collected in a laboratory setting without electromagnetic shielding to simulate real-world usage conditions. This dataset was derived from the original Zenodo publication (10.5281/zenodo.2617084) and converted to BIDS format using MOABB.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a 16-channel g.USBamp system with wet electrodes in a standard 10-20 montage (reference: right earlobe, ground: AFz) at 512 Hz sampling rate. Subjects sat approximately 50 cm from a screen without noise-reduction devices. Each of 10 blocks consisted of 1 minute of eyes-open EEG recording while listening to Bach Invention compositions. Smartphone conditions (switched-on/off) were randomized across blocks with triggers marking condition onset. Data were recorded with no digital filtering and no Faraday cage to simulate real-world usage conditions. The dataset was subsequently converted to BIDS format using MOABB (Mother of All BCI Benchmarks) version 1.5.0.
